mapper.sql: id, create_time, update_time, create_user_name, create_user_id, update_user_name, update_user_id, version, is_deleted, code, so_code, so_id, dict_platform, platform_code, third_warehouse_platform
mapper.select: select twd.id, twd.so_id as soId, twd.code, twd.dict_platform as platform, sb.shop_id as shopId, twd.so_code as soCode, twd.platform_code as platformOrderCode, sb.shipping_order_no as thirdCode, twd.status, sbl.code as transportNo, sbl.track_no as trackNo, sbl.logistics_channel_id as channelId, sbl.logistics_channel_name as channelName, twdd.sku_no as skuNo, twdd.platform_sku_no as platformSkuNo, twdd.delivery_qty as qty, twdd.warehouse_id as warehouseId, twd.create_time as createTime, sb.so_outstock_date as outstockDate, sb.sign_order_error as signOrderError from third_warehouse_delivery twd inner join third_warehouse_delivery_detail twdd on twd.id = twdd.main_id and twdd.is_deleted = false inner join so_b2c sb on twd.so_id = sb.id and sb.is_deleted = false inner join so_b2c_logistics sbl on sbl.main_id = sb.id and sbl.is_deleted = false where ${params.sqlMap.default} and twd.is_deleted = false order by twd.create_time desc
select status as tabFlag, count(1) as count from third_warehouse_delivery where is_deleted = false group by status
